services.title: Business Permits & Licensing (eBPLS)
services.short_description: Apply for, renew, and track city business permits online through Davao City's digital licensing portal.
services.tip: Track existing permit applications in real-time using your application reference code.

services.title: Online Building Permit System (OBPS)
services.short_description: Submit building plans, zoning clearances, and construction permits with transparent digital review.
services.department: Office of the City Building Official
services.tip: Check structural and architectural clearance statuses directly from the tracking dashboard.

services.title: Community Tax Certificate (Online Cedula)
services.short_description: File community tax applications online for employment, notarization, and banking requirements.
services.tip: Generate your payment reference code before heading to authorized payment windows.

services.title: Real Property Tax & City Payments
services.short_description: Electronic assessment and payment channels for real property taxes, regulatory fees, and city dues.
services.tip: Early bird payment discounts are typically announced during the first quarter of the fiscal year.

services.title: Lingap para sa Mahirap Medical Aid
services.short_description: City government medical subsidies, hospitalization bills support, and funeral aid for indigent families.
services.department: City Social Welfare and Development Office (CSWDO)
services.tip: Bring valid government ID, medical abstract, and hospital billing statement to expedite processing.

services.title: Local Civil Registry Services
services.short_description: Processing and certified copies of Certificates of Live Birth, Marriage, and Death records.
services.tip: Appointments can be scheduled ahead to avoid long lines during peak hours.

services.title: City Government Career Opportunities
services.short_description: Explore vacant permanent, contractual, and job-order opportunities within Davao City LGU departments.
services.tip: Review CSC eligibility requirements and submission deadlines before submitting your PDS.

services.title: Sangguniang Panlungsod Legislative Portal
services.short_description: Read approved ordinances, council committee hearings, and legislative session agendas.
services.tip: Search public hearing notices to participate in local policy discussions.
